The reply you can read stays; the horse head beside it opens a usable interactive layer.

## Scenes worth trying

### "Give me a checklist I can tick off, with a place for notes."

Reply enhancement (chat three-dot menu) adds an optional A2UI interactive layer after the normal reply settles. The horse head beside the final reply is the entry: font color when enhancement is off, a bottom-up theme-color ripple while the interactive page is generating, solid theme color when ready. Click opens the result in the nm viewer when enabled, otherwise in the system default browser; right-click offers the opposite method. It works the same whether evolution is on or off, and each evolution branch opens its own result.

### "Keep the answer in my language, including the visible thinking."

The AI language guard strengthens the prompt and checks visible output language. When enabled it buffers a complete response before showing it, and regenerates the natural-language delivery at most twice per task without replaying tools. If it still does not comply, the original output is shown as-is with no warning or badge. Language requests and complaints are recorded only as background review material.

### "Remember with evidence, and let me find why something was forgotten."

Background memory now does progressive recall (authorization first, short cards before originals, bounded query variants and one-hop expansion), a virtual directory with three-level expansion, a derived project overview, and bounded local recall traces. New facts append and mark older statements superseded without deleting them; a confirmed same-source misreading deletes the wrong derived record and keeps a tombstone so rebuild or sync cannot revive it. Original chat text is never rewritten.

## Also in this release

- The chat scrollbar thumb hides when idle and the pointer leaves the scrollbar slot; it appears on actual scrolling, slot hover or drag. Gutter width and scroll position are unchanged.

- Project isolation uses a stable, immutable project ID; directory and repository address are binding information only. The host determines the allowed scope; model-supplied project/URI/bank names cannot change permissions.

- The license is now the Pondsi Attribution License: any use (original, modified, snippets, personal or distributed) with a single condition — credit Pondsi. No repository link or full-license retention is required. Third-party dependencies, model weights and assets keep their own licenses.

## Honest boundaries

- Language detection is heuristic: short or uncertain text is left alone, and near-language pairs can be uncertain. Enabling the guard adds local checks and up to two extra model calls per task; it does not guarantee the model always complies, and latency differs from the off state.

- Interactive replies send the question and reply text in a second call to the same provider used for the normal reply. Generation may fail without changing the normal reply. Enhancement is off by default.

- Derived memory (overview, observations, traces) is not the original record; corrections require evidence and never rewrite chat originals. Model output and generated files still need review. Permissions remain per session, and no self-improvement can disable the safety boundaries.

## Install

Download WArmy-Setup-0.4.50.exe from this release and run it. Existing WArmyData carries over. The installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. The installer SHA-256 is listed in the Checksum section below. First run stops at the language page and waits for you.
